title: Former Morgan Stanley CEO’s NYC mansion listed for $80M
summary_full: On the market for a staggering $80 million, the historic New York City carriage house owned by John Mack and Christy Mack represents a remarkable investment opportunity. Acquired for $13.5 million in 2009, the property underwent an extensive six-year renovation.
